original:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः ।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥
sanskrit:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः ।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥
transliteration:
dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ |
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kim akurvata sañjaya ||
translation: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, assembled on the sacred field of Kurukshetra, eager for battle, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do?

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: धृतराष्ट्र ने कहा: हे संजय! धर्मभूमि कुरुक्षेत्र में युद्ध की इच्छा से एकत्र हुए मेरे पुत्रों और पाण्डु के पुत्रों ने क्या किया?

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: धृतराष्ट्र म्हणाला: हे संजया! धर्मभूमी कुरुक्षेत्रावर युद्धाच्या इच्छेने जमलेल्या माझ्या पुत्रांनी आणि पांडवांनी काय केले?

layers.author: adi_shankara
layers.content: Shankara opens his Gita Bhashya by explaining that Kurukshetra is called Dharmakshetra because performing righteous actions there yields immediate spiritual purification.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: Bhishma Parva contains the crowning jewel of Vedic literature, the 700 verses of the Srimad Bhagavad Gita.
